text:
mira: Quick thought 1: add a compact 'Cost Peek' badge beside routes that surfaces token burn anomaly + top 3 model SKUs. Click opens modal with sample_count, estimated cache savings, and CSV export. Low risk, high signal.

dan: Nice. How do we detect anomalies? rolling median by hour-of-day and flag >3x. Need to reduce noisy alerts for bursty traffic.

mira: Exactly. Baseline = median over last 24h same hour bucket. Confidence = sample_count buckets (low/med/high).

oliver: Can we avoid new high-cardinality events? I'd rather reuse token_telemetry and run a lightweight sampler job.

tessa: Agreed. We'll sample 1/100 requests into an aggregator table and emit small aggregates. TTL 6h.

sam: Permissions: show percent delta public, absolute $ + CSV only to billing/admin roles. CSV redacts PII by default.

dan: API prototype: GET /internal/cost-peek?route_gv=...&window=1h -> {percent_delta, sample_count, confidence, top_models}. Keep shape tiny.

oliver: Auth: console service account + org rate limit 10 rps. Cache responses server-side for 10m.

tessa: Instrumentation: emit `cost_peek_sample` with route_gv, sample_count, baseline, current_window. Low-cardinality only.

ops-bot: ticket created PERF-1129 "cost-peek-badge-and-modal" assigned to tessa,dan,mira,sam.

mira: UX: color-coded dot on row (+ hover quick numbers). Modal: 15m sparkline, top SKUs, export button.

dan: Edge case: routes with <30 samples show "insufficient data" and never mark red.

sam: CSV retention: exports are logged but CSV content not stored; audit rows kept 30d.

tessa: Rollout: feature-flag, internal canary, then 10% orgs for 48h. Monitor `cost_peek_render` and `cost_peek_export` events. Sync tomorrow 11am to land proto.
